subject: P5-MS2: per-session transcript binding (replace mainTranscript singleton)
description: POST /workspace and POST /agent/start already carry session + transcript_path; stop overwriting a single state.mainTranscript (last IDE wins). Persist state.sessions[sessionId] = { harness?, transcript, workspace, lastSeen } inferred from transcript path prefix or hook payload. taskTranscript() / harnessTranscriptForTask() resolve via agent.transcript_path first, then sessions map, never a global mainTranscript. /health and /meta expose session count not a boolean mainTranscript. Multi-IDE concurrent connections on one workspace each retain their own transcript binding.
